title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Tell them why
hook: Do your players know why they are doing this drill?
intro: They do not know what it is for.
statement: A reason turns a drill into a skill they will use.
q1: Do you explain why before each drill —
q2: or let them play and explain after?
q3: Could a player tell a parent why it matters?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But effort goes up
t2: when kids know how a drill helps in games.
cta: Coaches — do you explain the why?
ctaLines: One sentence before. Ask them after. Show a video.
ctaPrompt: Share your teaching habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Do your players know why they are doing this drill?
Kids run the drill. They do not know what it is for.
A reason turns a drill into a skill they will use.
Explain before or after. Every team is different.
Do you explain the why? Share your habit in the comments.
